mapper.insert: MERGE INTO byai_group_chat_mention target USING ( SELECT CAST(#{messageId} AS BIGINT) AS message_id, CAST(#{groupSessionId} AS BIGINT) AS group_session_id, CAST(#{mentionedUserId} AS BIGINT) AS mentioned_user_id, CAST(#{creatorId} AS BIGINT) AS creator_id, CAST(#{createTime} AS TIMESTAMP) AS create_time ) source ON ( target.message_id = source.message_id AND target.mentioned_user_id = source.mentioned_user_id ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( message_id, group_session_id, mentioned_user_id, creator_id, create_time ) VALUES ( source.message_id, source.group_session_id, source.mentioned_user_id, source.creator_id, source.create_time )
mapper.sql: COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM byai_group_chat_mention mention JOIN byai_message mentioned_message ON mentioned_message.session_id = mention.group_session_id AND mentioned_message.message_id = mention.message_id AND mentioned_message.archived_at IS NULL WHERE mention.group_session_id = session.session_id AND mention.mentioned_user_id = #{userId} AND mention.message_id > COALESCE(member.last_read_message_id, 0) ), 0) AS unread_mention_count, ( SELECT MAX(mention.message_id) FROM byai_group_chat_mention mention JOIN byai_message mentioned_message ON mentioned_message.session_id = mention.group_session_id AND mentioned_message.message_id = mention.message_id AND mentioned_message.archived_at IS NULL WHERE mention.group_session_id = session.session_id AND mention.mentioned_user_id = #{userId} AND mention.message_id > COALESCE(member.last_read_message_id, 0) ) AS latest_mention_message_id
mapper.select:
SELECT session.session_id, session.session_name, session.project_id, member.user_role, member.last_read_message_id, latest.message_id AS latest_message_id, latest.message_content AS latest_message_content, latest.create_time AS latest_message_time, latest.creator_id AS latest_message_creator_id, latest.creator_name AS latest_message_creator_name,
FROM byai_session_member member JOIN byai_session session ON session.session_id = member.session_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT message.session_id, message.message_id, message.message_content, message.create_time, message.creator_id, message.creator_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY message.session_id ORDER BY message.create_time DESC, message.message_id DESC ) AS latest_row_num FROM byai_message message WHERE message.archived_at IS NULL ) latest ON latest.session_id = session.session_id AND latest.latest_row_num = 1 WHERE member.mem_obj_type = 'USER' AND member.mem_obj_id = #{userId} AND session.session_type = 'hs_as' ORDER BY COALESCE(latest.create_time, session.update_time, session.create_time) DESC, session.session_id DESC

SELECT session.session_id, member.last_read_message_id,
FROM byai_session_member member JOIN byai_session session ON session.session_id = member.session_id WHERE member.mem_obj_type = 'USER' AND member.mem_obj_id = #{userId} AND member.session_id = #{sessionId} AND session.session_type = 'hs_as'
